description: The CHANGELOG (and by extension REQ-AS-002's claim that pm-trade 'already writes the EXACT contract is_fresh_but_barren needs') is factually inaccurate. sol-trade/run.sh genuinely has a clean 2-state trace vocabulary -- action is EITHER 'skip' (3 mechanism-failure gates: kill-switch, identity-mismatch, earn-guard breach; sol-trade/run.sh:22,39,46) OR 'live-pass' (a real agent decision; sol-trade/run.sh:152) -- so is_fresh_but_barren's action=="skip"-only predicate correctly sees every sustained mechanism failure sol-trade can produce. pm-trade/run.sh does NOT have that same clean vocabulary: it has a THIRD, untracked failure mode -- action:"error" -- fired when AGENT_HOME is missing (polymarket-trade/run.sh:22-23) or when pick.py exits non-zero (polymarket-trade/run.sh:184-186). Neither of these is action=="skip", so is_fresh_but_barren (earning-health.py:45: `entry.get("action") == "skip"`) can NEVER flag them, no matter how many consecutive wakes hit them. A real, plausible scenario -- e.g. PM_TRADE_AGENT_HOME getting wiped/misconfigured, or pick.py permanently crashing (a code/env bug, not a trading decision) -- would write action:"error" on every single wake forever, and earning-health-allslots.sh would report 'earn/polymarket-trade OK' forever, never escalating self-fix. This is EXACTLY the 'alive but mechanically broken, undetected' blind spot the whole self-heal-allslots feature exists to close (see earning-health.py's own docstring, lines 2-8) -- and it silently exists for one of the two slots this sprint claims to have fully, correctly wired.

evidence.snippet:
echo "{\"ts\":\"$(now)\",\"slot\":\"earn/pm-trade\",\"action\":\"error\",\"error\":\"agent home missing: $AGENT_HOME\"}" >> "$TRACE"
...
echo "{\"ts\":\"$(now)\",\"slot\":\"earn/pm-trade\",\"action\":\"error\",\"error\":\"pick.py failed rc=$PICK_RC\"}" >> "$TRACE"

crossReference.compareAgainst: skills/earn/sol-trade/run.sh:22,39,46,152 (skip/live-pass only, no error state) and skills/self/earning-health.py:45 (`entry.get("action") == "skip"` -- the only branch that can ever return True/BARREN)
crossReference.claimUnderTest: .vcsdd/features/self-heal-allslots/CHANGELOG.md line 40-45: "both [sol-trade, pm-trade] already write a dedicated per-wake {\"action\":\"skip\",\"reason\":\"...\"} trace ... the EXACT contract is_fresh_but_barren needs. Wiring these was a direct, safe generalization"
